text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Corina Müller Könz began her law studies at the University of Fribourg, which included a year abroad at the Universidad Central de Barcelona, and graduated in 1994 with a bilingual degree.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Prior to that, she worked at the Guardianship Service of Biel/Bienne."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Con un master in legge, Valerie Berger (*1980) dal 1° ottobre 2023 ricopre la carica di direttrice del campo di prestazioni Libera circolazione delle persone e Relazioni di lavoro.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Valerie Berger\nValerie Berger (*1980), Master of Law (MLaw), has been head of the Free Movement of Persons and Labour Relations Division since 1 October 2023."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Da agosto 2022 a settembre 2023 ha coordinato il settore Sorveglianza del mercato di lavoro; mentre da luglio 2016 a luglio 2022 il settore Contratti collettivi di lavoro.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "She was previously head of the Labour Market Supervision Section between August 2022 and September 2023 and head of the Collective Labour Agreements Section between July 2016 and July 2022."}]}
